findings: output_word unfolds the literal factory MSTORE/RETURN memory expression, proves the 32-byte write fits both initializer images, normalizes actual write/readWithPadding, and derives exactly extract12..32 of the word bytes. No execution or desired output premise is used.

address_bytes proves the existing AccountAddress.toByteArray zero-padding encoding equals fixed-width 20-byte big-endian digits. It handles both permitted machine USize widths and proves bounds before simplifying modular subtraction; it does not assume host pointer-width arithmetic is natural arithmetic.

address_word_bytes derives address.val<UInt256.size from the address type bound, eliminates ofNat wrapping, then equates the 20 selected digits of the 32-byte word with the 20 address digits. The exponent alignment 32-1-(12+i)=20-1-i is correct for i<20.
output_address composes the two generic equalities for every kind/address. output_size independently establishes exactly20 output bytes for any word.
The ffi.ByteArray.zeroes use is reduced through its transparent Lean array-replicate body, not an assumed external hash/native result. All printed exports have only standard axioms.
